services.name: web-shop
services.description: The shop customers open in a browser. Renders pages on the server and calls the API gateway for everything else.

services.name: mobile-bff
services.description: Backend for the iOS and Android apps: one call per screen, shaped for a phone on a slow network.

services.name: api-gateway
services.description: The single way in: routing, rate limits and the check of every access token.

services.name: identity
services.description: Sign-in, sessions and access tokens for customers and staff.

services.name: catalog
services.description: Products, categories and their pictures. The source of truth for what can be sold.

services.name: search
services.description: Full-text search and suggestions over the catalog.

services.name: search-index
services.description: Keeps the search cluster in step with the catalog by reading its change events.

services.name: cart
services.description: The basket of a customer, kept across devices.

services.name: pricing
services.description: The price of a basket: list prices, taxes and whatever promotions grants.

services.name: promotions
services.description: Vouchers and campaigns. Asks pricing for list prices to work out a discount, while pricing asks it for the discounts: a cycle worth untangling.

services.name: checkout
services.description: Turns a basket into a paid order, step by step.

services.name: payments
services.description: Talks to the card and wallet providers and records every attempt.

services.name: fraud-check
services.description: Scores a payment before it is sent to the provider.

services.name: ledger
services.description: Double-entry bookkeeping of every movement of money.

services.name: orders
services.description: Orders and their states, from placed to delivered.

services.name: inventory
services.description: Stock per warehouse, and reservations while an order is being paid.

services.name: shipping
services.description: Books carriers, prints labels and follows parcels.

services.name: notifications
services.description: E-mail, SMS and push messages, with templates and a do-not-disturb list.

services.name: reporting
services.description: Nightly sales and stock reports for finance and the warehouses.

services.name: feature-flags
services.description: Switches features on for a share of customers without a deployment.

services.name: session-cache
services.description: The shared in-memory store for sessions and baskets.

services.name: event-bus
services.description: The message broker every service publishes its changes to.

services.name: postgres-main
services.description: The main database cluster. Each service has its own schema.

services.name: object-store
services.description: Files: product pictures, labels, report exports.
